 Weather forecast for tonight and tomorrow (October 23, 2026): Sunny in the North, scattered thunderstorms in the South at night.
 Weather forecast for the mainland over the next 24 hours: Northern Vietnam will have sunny days with fog in the early morning; Central and Southern Vietnam should be wary of thunderstorms with the risk of tornadoes, lightning, and strong winds.
 Báo Lâm Đồng • 22/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Over the next 24 hours, the Northern region will maintain sunny weather, with some areas experiencing fog in the early morning and scattered showers in the evening. Conversely, the Central, Central Highlands, and Southern regions will continue to experience scattered showers and thunderstorms in the evening and night, with the potential for dangerous weather phenomena.
 Weather highlights for the next 24 hours
 Northern Vietnam and Hanoi : Sunny day, maximum temperatures generally ranging from 31-35 degrees Celsius, foggy in some areas in the early morning, scattered showers in the evening and at night.
 Central Vietnam and the Central Highlands: Cloudy, with scattered showers and thunderstorms in some areas. During thunderstorms, be wary of tornadoes, lightning, and strong gusts of wind.
 Southern Vietnam and Ho Chi Minh City: Intermittent sunshine during the day, with scattered showers and thunderstorms tonight, and localized strong gusts of wind. 
 Regional forecasts for inland areas.
 Northern Vietnam
 You may also like Hanoi: Cloudy, with occasional showers and thunderstorms in the evening and night, some fog in the early morning, sunny during the day. Light wind. Lowest temperature 25-27 degrees, highest temperature 32-34 degrees.
 Northwest region: Cloudy, with scattered showers and thunderstorms in the evening and night, some fog in the early morning, sunny during the day. Light wind. Lowest temperature 22-25 degrees Celsius, some places below 21 degrees Celsius; highest temperature 32-35 degrees Celsius.
 Northeast Vietnam: Cloudy, with scattered showers and thunderstorms in the evening and night, some fog in the early morning, sunny during the day. Light winds. Lowest temperature 23-26 degrees Celsius, below 22 degrees Celsius in mountainous areas; highest temperature 31-34 degrees Celsius.
 North Central Vietnam
 Thanh Hoa to Hue: Cloudy, with scattered showers and thunderstorms in some areas. Light winds. There is a possibility of tornadoes, lightning, and strong gusts of wind during thunderstorms. Lowest temperature 23-26 degrees Celsius, highest temperature 30-33 degrees Celsius.
 Central Vietnam
 South Central Coast: Cloudy, with scattered showers and thunderstorms in some areas. Northeast to north winds at level 2-3. There is a possibility of tornadoes, lightning, and strong gusts of wind during thunderstorms. Lowest temperature 23-26 degrees Celsius; highest temperature 30-33 degrees Celsius, with some areas exceeding 33 degrees Celsius.
 Central Highlands
 Central Highlands: Cloudy, with scattered showers and thunderstorms in some areas. Light winds. There is a possibility of tornadoes, lightning, and strong gusts of wind during thunderstorms. Lowest temperature 19-22 degrees Celsius, highest temperature 29-32 degrees Celsius.
 Southern Vietnam
 Southern Vietnam: Cloudy, with scattered showers and thunderstorms in some areas, especially tonight. Light winds. There is a possibility of tornadoes, lightning, and strong gusts of wind during thunderstorms. Lowest temperature 23-26 degrees Celsius, highest temperature 31-34 degrees Celsius.
 Ho Chi Minh City: Cloudy, with scattered showers and thunderstorms in some areas, especially tonight. Light winds. There is a possibility of tornadoes, lightning, and strong gusts of wind during thunderstorms. Lowest temperature 24-26 degrees Celsius, highest temperature 32-34 degrees Celsius.
 Dangerous weather warning
 Areas from Thanh Hoa to Hue , the South Central Coast, the Central Highlands, and the Southern region need to be wary of tornadoes, lightning, and strong gusts of wind during thunderstorms. People traveling on roads or working outdoors should proactively seek safe shelter when thunderstorms develop.
 You may also like People in the northern provinces should be aware of early morning fog that reduces visibility, while those in the southern regions should monitor thunderstorms in the evening to plan their travel routes accordingly. 
 * This article was created with the support of artificial intelligence (AI) from weather forecasts provided by the National Center for Meteorological and Hydrological Forecasting.
